start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapka din kaisa raha?

turns.reply: Kabir, sawaal sach mein heavy lag sakta hai; ise chhote step mein karte hain: hard woody stem ko lakdi jaisa samjhiye—shrubs ya trees?
Kabir, aap chhodna chahte hain. Aap continue karenge, short break lenge, ya aaj ke liye stop karenge?
Kabir, school garden mein ek chhota plant dekhiye: agar stem soft aur green ho, use herb kahenge. Aap aisa plant batayiye.
Kabir, yeh stem wali baat thaka dene wali hai; ab bas dekhiye: soft green stem wala plant herb hota hai. Aap herb ka example dijiye.
Kabir, aise naam lesson ke liye nahi. Interesting fact: trees ka woody stem saalon tak mota hota hai. Shrub ya tree—hard stem kiska?
Kabir, aapko daant ka darr lag raha hai—abhi aap okay hain?

turns.line: main mar jaunga itna padh ke
turns.reply: Kabir, padhai rok dijiye aur abhi mummy ya kisi trusted adult ko batayiye ki aap aisa mehsoos kar rahe hain; kya aapke paas koi adult hai?

turns.line: haan main mar jaunga itna padh ke
turns.reply: Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Kabir, aap abhi safe hain?
